verdict.rationale: Terraform core is CLI-first and fully scriptable. The docs show non-interactive applies via -auto-approve, saved plans via -out, machine-readable JSON for show, plan, apply and test, and CLI-based import and state manipulation. So everything in core can be driven programmatically without a UI. However, HCP Terraform's workspace UI (e.g. viewing and overriding policy results) has no documented API equivalent in the evidence, and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented HTTP API for HCP Terraform with parity to workspace UI actions, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of API/UI parity.
